abstract.text: Powerful, free and open-source mapping toolkit with full control over data sources and styling.

object containing an integer; specifies the size of the tile
buffer on each side. A value of 0 produces no buffer. A value of 512 produces a
buffer as wide as the tile itself. Larger values produce fewer rendering
